2609.24410.title: End-to-end Jordanian dialect speech-to-text self-supervised learning framework
2609.24410.paper_summary: Speech-to-text engines are extremely needed nowadays for different applications, representing an essential enabler in human-robot interaction. Still, some languages suffer from the lack of labeled speech data, especially in the Arabic dialects or any low-resource languages. The need for a self-supervised training process and self-training using noisy training is proven to be one of the up-and-coming feasible solutions. This article proposes an end-to-end, transformers-based model with a framework for low-resource languages. In addition, the framework incorporates customized audio-to-text processing algorithms to achieve a highly efficient Jordanian Arabic dialect speech-to-text system. The proposed framework enables ingesting data from many sources, making the ground truth from external sources possible by speeding up the manual annotation process. The framework allows the training process using noisy student training and self-supervised learning to utilize the unlabeled data in both pre- and post-training stages and incorporate multiple types of data augmentation. The proposed self-training approach outperforms the fine-tuned Wav2Vec model by 5% in terms of word error rate reduction. The outcome of this work provides the research community with a Jordanian-spoken data set along with an end-to-end approach to deal with low-resource languages. This is done by utilizing the power of the pretraining, post-training, and injecting noisy labeled and augmented data with minimal human intervention. It enables the development of new applications in the field of Arabic language speech-to-text area like the question-answering systems and intelligent control systems, and it will add human-like perception and hearing sensors to intelligent robots.
2609.24410.paper_summary_zh: 語音轉文字引擎在當今的各種應用中極為需要，成為人機互動的重要推動力。<lb/>然而，一些語言尤其是阿拉伯方言或任何低資源語言，面臨標記語音數據的缺乏。<lb/>自我監督訓練過程和使用噪音訓練的自我訓練被證明是新興的可行解決方案之一。<lb/>本文提出了一種基於端到端的Transformer模型，並為低資源語言提供了一個框架。<lb/>此外，該框架結合了定制的音頻轉文本處理算法，以實現高效的約旦阿拉伯方言語音轉文字系統。<lb/>所提框架能夠從多個來源獲取數據，通過加速手動標註過程使外部來源的真實數據成為可能。<lb/>該框架允許使用噪音學生訓練和自我監督學習進行訓練過程，以利用未標記數據於訓練前和訓練後的階段，並結合多種類型的數據增強。<lb/>所提出的自我訓練方法在詞錯誤率降低方面比微調的Wav2Vec模型提高了5%。<lb/>這項工作的結果為研究界提供了一個約旦口語數據集以及一種處理低資源語言的端到端方法。<lb/>這是通過利用預訓練、後訓練的力量，以及最小人為干預下注入噪音標記和增強數據來實現的。<lb/>它使得在阿拉伯語語音轉文字領域開發新應用成為可能，如問答系統和智能控制系統，並將人類般的感知和聽覺傳感器添加到智能機器人中。
